text: The claude-code adapter does not offer the harness scheduling tools (ScheduleWakeup and CronCreate/CronList/CronDelete) to the model — they are hard-suppressed via custom_env (CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON=1) and/or disallowedTools, with no config gate to re-enable them.
